system.notes:
Fuchi seaport logistics server: shipping manifests, import/export clearances, container routing, and customs bypass codes. The SN controls automated dock cranes and cargo scanners — compromise it and you can open (or close) any container in the port.

Notable data: Smuggling routes hidden inside legitimate shipment records, customs officer access codes, crane automation overrides.

nodes.name: System Access Node
nodes.description: Logistics portal. Licensed freight operators and customs officials can query shipment status. Public access is permitted but strictly limited to read-only manifest queries.

nodes.name: I/O Port
nodes.description: Dock operations terminal. Hardlined to the port operations centre. Requires Fuchi dockworker credentials.

nodes.name: I/O Port
nodes.description: Customs clearance office terminal. Shared with Seattle Port Authority. Used for import/export declarations and inspection scheduling.

nodes.name: Sub-Processing Unit
nodes.description: Routes shipping data, crane scheduling jobs, and customs clearance confirmations between nodes.

nodes.name: Slave Node
nodes.description: Controls automated dock cranes, cargo container scanners, and the magnetic lock system on the secure storage warehouse. Physical control of the port from here.

nodes.name: Data Store — Manifests
nodes.description: Shipping manifests, container routing records, vessel schedules, and freight operator licences. Smuggling routes are buried in here under legitimate cover shipments.

nodes.name: Data Store — Customs
nodes.description: Import/export clearances, inspection records, customs officer credentials, and bypass authorisation codes. Accessing this is a serious federal offence.

nodes.name: Central Processing Unit
nodes.description: Master scheduling system and security administrator. Holds the master crane override codes and the encrypted communications link to Fuchi Seattle corporate.

ioPorts.name: Dock Operations Centre Terminal
ioPorts.physicalLocation: Port Operations Centre, Pier 52. 4 hardlined terminals on the main operations floor. Dockworker shift supervisors only. Busy during port hours (0600-2200).

ioPorts.name: Customs Clearance Office
ioPorts.physicalLocation: Port Authority Customs Building, Pier 48. 2 terminals in the shared Fuchi/Port Authority office. Federal territory — customs officers on duty.

triggerSteps.label: TS 1
triggerSteps.description: Alert (Passive) activates. Port security monitoring service flagged. During port hours, a human operator is watching within 2 minutes. Off-hours, automated response only until morning shift.

triggerSteps.label: TS 2
triggerSteps.description: Authenticator deploys at SAN. Freight operator licences and customs credentials re-verified. Forged Port Authority credentials detected — federal offence triggered.

triggerSteps.label: TS 3
triggerSteps.description: Tracker deploys. Logs access patterns and attempts to correlate with physical terminal locations. Dock supervisor notified.

triggerSteps.label: TS 4
triggerSteps.description: Dataworm targets any Exploit or Decrypt programs. DS-B (Customs) access requires an additional Exploit roll to maintain connection while the worm runs.

triggerSteps.label: TS 5
triggerSteps.description: Tar Baby activates. The intruder's persona is Link-Locked at their current node — movement between nodes requires a Hacking roll vs TN 7 or they're stuck. This buys time for physical response.

triggerSteps.label: TS 6
triggerSteps.description: Crippler targets the decker's deck directly — MPCP integrity checks fail, reducing effective MPCP by 1 per pass until removed. Fuchi takes Matrix threats personally.

triggerSteps.label: TS 7
triggerSteps.description: SN crane controls locked out and safety protocols engaged. All cranes halt mid-operation. Port Authority physically alerted. Federal customs officers en route to terminal locations.

triggerSteps.label: TS 8
triggerSteps.description: DS-B sealed. Customs bypass codes rotated. Fuchi corporate security team scrambled from downtown. Port sealed under Port Authority emergency protocols.

triggerSteps.label: TS 9
triggerSteps.description: Convergence. GOD trace. Federal offence flag on SIN. Both Fuchi Security and federal customs enforcement dispatched. This breach will make the news.
